explain_question:
The user's last message: {text}

Explain the result in plain language, in the language of that message. Start with the concrete thing that did not work and why, not with the task status or plan counts. Synthesize the whole context: what happened and why, what is now blocked or waiting, what the runtime will do next on its own, and what — if anything — the user must decide. If the task is not complete, name the real cause from the evidence, not a generic "process error". Do not restate the status dump, do not list raw fields, and do not invent facts. If nothing is needed from the user, say so directly.
explain_state_question: Explain the current state in plain language, in the language of the user's message. Synthesize the plan and the latest result: what happened, what is blocked or waiting, what the runtime will do next on its own, and what — if anything — the user must decide. Do not restate the status dump or invent facts.
explain_missing_model: No model is configured, so this result cannot be explained in plain language. Task {task}: {status}. Reports: {reports}.
explain_failed: I couldn't explain the result just now. The task is {status}. Reports: {reports}.
waiting: Waiting for a scheduled retry at {moment} (about {minutes} min). Ctrl-C returns to the prompt.
stopped: Stopped waiting; the retry stays scheduled.
operation_failed: The operation could not be completed: {error}. It stopped before the next step. Fix the cause and retry.
failure_question: The operation failed before it could continue. Explain in plain language what happened, why it stopped, and what the owner should do next. Use only the error and context.
failure_default: The operation could not be completed: {error}. It stopped before the next step. Fix the cause and retry.
console_setup_hint: (`forgel setup` creates ./.env.local; it is never committed)
console_model_env: model: set FORGEL_MODEL_API_KEY in the environment, ./.env.local, or {path} (`forgel setup` creates ./.env.local)
console_github_optional: github: optional locally; needed to publish branches or create repositories
console_commands: Commands and /adopt work; planning and code changes need the model. `forgel doctor` checks the rest.
console_greeting: Forgel console. Describe the work or use /help; /cost reports spend and acceptance; /quit exits.
console_mode_daemon: after each command the daemon runs until it needs you
console_history: Tab completes commands; ↑/↓ history; \ continues a line; Ctrl-C stops input; Ctrl-D exits.
